dashboard.label: Process Tree
dashboard.description: Process creation, parent-child relationships, and command lines via Sysmon EID 1

search.query: index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 | stats count by host | fields host

index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 host=$host_filter$ | search Image="*$process_filter$*" CommandLine="*$cmdline_filter$*" | table _time, host, User, ParentImage, ParentCommandLine, Image, CommandLine, ProcessId, ParentProcessId, Hashes | sort -_time
index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 host=$selected_host$ ParentProcessId=$selected_pid$ | table _time, User, Image, CommandLine, ProcessId | sort _time

index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=3 host=$selected_host$ ProcessId=$selected_pid$ | table _time, Image, SourceIp, SourcePort, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, Protocol | sort _time

index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 host=$host_filter$ | search (ParentImage="*cmd.exe" OR ParentImage="*powershell.exe" OR ParentImage="*wscript.exe" OR ParentImage="*mshta.exe" OR ParentImage="*wmiprvse.exe" OR ParentImage="*services.exe" OR ParentImage="*svchost.exe" OR ParentImage="*taskeng.exe" OR ParentImage="*w3wp.exe") | where NOT match(Image, "(?i)(conhost\.exe|splunkd\.exe)") | table _time, host, User, ParentImage, Image, CommandLine | sort -_time

index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4688 host=$host_filter$ | table _time, host, Account_Name, Creator_Process_Name, New_Process_Name, Process_Command_Line, New_Process_ID, Creator_Process_ID | sort -_time
index=linux sourcetype="linux:audit" type=EXECVE | table _time, host, a0, a1, a2, a3 | sort -_time
